faq.description: Answers to common questions about choosing and buying coffee for home, cafes, and businesses.

arabicaRobusta.question: Is Arabica better than Robusta?
arabicaRobusta.answer: Arabica and Robusta differ in flavor, aroma, caffeine content, and cup characteristics. The right choice depends on your taste, brewing method, and the coffee experience you are looking for.

espresso.question: What is the best coffee for espresso?
espresso.answer: The right coffee for espresso depends on your preferred flavor, intensity, and blend. Different Arabica and Robusta combinations can create different espresso experiences.

caffeine.question: Which type of coffee has more caffeine?
caffeine.answer: Robusta generally contains more caffeine than Arabica. If you prefer a coffee with higher caffeine content, you can explore blends with a higher percentage of Robusta.

chooseCoffee.question: How do I choose the right coffee for me?
chooseCoffee.answer: Choosing the right coffee depends on your preferred flavor, caffeine level, brewing method, and how you plan to drink it. For home use, you can explore coffees based on your needs.

cafe.question: What type of coffee is suitable for a cafe?
cafe.answer: Choosing coffee for a cafe depends on the menu, customer preferences, consumption volume, and desired blend. Explore Farajahan's coffee selection for cafes.

business.question: What options are available for buying coffee in bulk?
business.answer: For businesses with higher coffee consumption, choosing the right blend and package size is important. Farajahan offers coffee products designed for different business needs.

hero.description: Our goal is to offer world-class products, a lasting flavor and a different coffee experience.

story.title: From 12 years of experience to the Farajahan brand
story.p1: With more than 12 years of experience in coffee processing, our company officially registered as "Ghahveh Gostaran Sanat Shargh" in 1398 (Solar Hijri) and began its activity under the Farajahan brand.
story.p2: The company's active research and development system plays a key role in producing world-class, health-oriented products.
story.p3: Quality has always been a priority in our policy. Relying on up-to-date knowledge and international experience in the coffee industry, we work to draw a clear vision for the years ahead, one in which we can satisfy the taste of those who love the unique aroma and flavor of coffee.
